{{short description|Complementary of a rank}}
{{More citations needed|date=February 2024}}
In [[mathematics]], '''corank''' is complementary to the concept of the rank of a mathematical object, and may refer to the dimension of the left [[Nullspace|nullspace of a matrix]], the dimension of the [[cokernel]] of a linear transformation of a [[vector space]], or the number of elements of a [[matroid]] minus its [[Matroid rank|rank]].<ref>{{cite book |last1=Loebl |first1=Martin |last2=Nešetřil |first2=Jaroslav |last3=Thomas |first3=Robin |title=A Journey Through Discrete Mathematics: A Tribute to Jiří Matoušek |date=11 October 2017 |publisher=Springer |isbn=978-3-319-44479-6 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=aHg5DwAAQBAJ&dq=%22Corank%22+-wikipedia+math+nullspace&pg=PA572 |language=en}}</ref>

== Left nullspace of a matrix ==
The corank of an <math>m\times n</math> [[Matrix (mathematics)|matrix]] is <math>m-r</math> where <math>r</math> is the [[rank (linear algebra)|rank]] of the matrix. It is the dimension of the [[left nullspace]] and of the [[cokernel]] of the matrix. For a square matrix <math>M</math>, the corank and nullity of <math>M</math> are equivalent.

== Cokernel of a linear transformation ==
Generalizing matrices to [[linear transformation]]s of [[vector space]]s, the corank of a linear transformation is the dimension of the [[cokernel]] of the transformation, which is the quotient of the [[codomain]] by the image of the transformation.

== Matroid ==
For a [[matroid]] with <math>n</math> elements and [[matroid rank]] <math>r</math>, the corank or nullity of the matroid is <math>n-r</math>. In the case of [[linear matroid]]s this coincides with the matrix corank. In the case of [[graphic matroid]]s the corank is also known as the [[circuit rank]] or cyclomatic number.
